x-pipelinq-forecast-lifecycle.description: Forecast-category state machine for deal roll-up. NOTE: this is a SECOND state machine on the lead schema (the OR-enforced `x-openregister-lifecycle` already owns the `status` field, and OpenRegister supports only one enforced lifecycle field per schema). It is therefore declared under a pipelinq-namespaced key and enforced by ForecastDealService + the deal listeners (revert-after-write), NOT by OpenRegister's LifecycleValidationListener. Rules: a closed category locks (a closed deal cannot move to an open category without reopening); reopening a closed deal resets the category to the default; a `commit` above the org threshold requires a justification. ForecastDealService reads the open/closed partition and default from here (ADR-031 source-of-truth).

forecast_category.description: Forecast confidence category for roll-up. Defaults to pipeline on create (applied by OpenRegister's schema-default with falsy behavior, matching the prior listener default). Locked once a deal is closed_won/closed_lost; reopening resets it to pipeline.

commit_justification.description: Free-text justification required when forecast_category is commit and value exceeds the org commit threshold. Visible to the rep's manager.

forecastSnapshot.title: Forecast Snapshot
forecastSnapshot.summary: An immutable point-in-time freeze of a rep/team/division/company forecast for a fiscal period.
forecastSnapshot.description: Generated automatically every Monday 06:00 (org timezone) and on demand. Captures commit/best_case/pipeline/closed_won amounts in the reporting currency plus the contributing deal ids. Never modified after creation; trend and accuracy analysis read the history. Roll-up levels sum the level below.

period_id.description: Identifier of the fiscal period (e.g. Q2-2026).

as_of_date.description: ISO 8601 date the snapshot was taken.

owner_id.description: NC user UID (rep) or team/division/company identifier.

commit_amount.description: Total commit forecast in the reporting currency.

quota_amount.description: Quota for this owner/period (null if unset).

currency.description: ISO 4217 reporting currency of all amounts.

deal_snapshot_ids.description: UUIDs of contributing deal objects (audit trail).

partial.description: True if a child snapshot was missing at generation time.

missing_reps.description: Names/UIDs of missing children when partial.

forecastOverride.title: Forecast Override
forecastOverride.summary: A manager-supplied amount that replaces the calculated roll-up at a level for a category.
forecastOverride.description: Immutable audit record. The original calculated amount stays visible alongside the override for transparency. Overrides cascade upward: a parent roll-up uses the child's override value, not its calculated value. Does not modify the underlying deals.

owner_id.description: NC user UID of the manager who owns the override.

override_owner_id.description: NC user UID or team/division id of the entity being overridden.

level.description: Level at which the override applies.

override_amount.description: Manager-supplied amount in the reporting currency.

original_amount.description: Calculated amount before the override (visual diff).

created_by.description: NC user UID of the manager who created the override.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp the override was created.

salesQuota.title: Sales Quota
salesQuota.summary: A quarterly quota target for a rep, team or division.
salesQuota.description: Defines the target attainment amount per owner and period. Quota hierarchy (sum of rep quotas vs team quota) is advisory, validated as a data-quality check, never enforced as a constraint.

owner_id.description: NC user UID (rep) or team/division identifier.

quota_amount.description: Target amount in the reporting currency.

effective_from.description: ISO date the quota becomes active.

set_by.description: NC user UID of the person who set this quota.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp the quota was created.
